description: This file provides a helper utility for retrieving device and platform information on iOS and iPadOS devices. It contains static methods within an enum to gather system version, device family, model identifier, app version, and build information, primarily for use in settings and payloads.

methods.name: platformString
methods.description: Returns a string representing the device's platform and OS version, e.g., 'iOS 18.0.0' or 'iPadOS 18.0.0', based on interface idiom.

methods.name: platformStringForDisplay
methods.description: Returns a display string for the OS version, formatted as 'iOS X.Y.Z'.

methods.name: deviceFamily
methods.description: Returns a string indicating the device family, such as 'iPad', 'iPhone', or 'iOS'.

methods.name: modelIdentifier
methods.description: Retrieves the machine model identifier (e.g., 'iPhone17,1') from uname.

methods.name: appVersion
methods.description: Gets the app's marketing version string, e.g., '2026.2.0' or 'dev'.

methods.name: appBuild
methods.description: Retrieves the app's build string, e.g., '123'.

methods.name: openClawVersionString
methods.description: Returns a combined version string for display, including app version and build if different.
